title: Return Policy
content: Our return policy allows customers to return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by the original receipt or order confirmation. Certain items are excluded from returns including: personalized items, final sale items, intimate apparel, and hazardous materials. To initiate a return, log into your account or contact customer service. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the return.

title: Shipping Policy
content: We offer multiple shipping options to meet your needs. Standard Shipping (5-7 business days): Free on orders over $50, $5.99 otherwise. Express Shipping (2-3 business days): $12.99. Same-Day Delivery: $19.99 in select areas. Orders placed before 2 PM EST ship the same day. Orders ship from our warehouses Monday through Friday. We ship to all 50 US states and over 50 countries internationally. Tracking information is provided for all orders.

title: Privacy Policy Summary
content: We collect information you provide directly, such as account details and payment information. We also collect browsing data to improve your experience. Your data is never sold to third parties. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your information. You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting privacy@example.com. We retain data for up to 7 years for compliance purposes. For full details, visit our Privacy Center.

title: Price Match Guarantee
content: We offer a price match guarantee. If you find a lower price on an identical item from an authorized retailer within 14 days of purchase, we will match it. To request a price match, contact customer service with the competitor's current advertised price, including the URL or advertisement. Excludes membership pricing, coupon codes, promotional offers, and marketplace sellers. Limit one price match per item per customer.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Orders may be cancelled within 1 hour of placement if they haven't entered processing. To cancel, log into your account or contact customer service immediately. Orders that have started processing or shipped cannot be cancelled but can be returned after delivery. Subscription orders must be cancelled 48 hours before the next shipment date. Cancelled orders are refunded within 3-5 business days.

title: Exchange Policy
content: We offer free exchanges within 30 days of delivery. To exchange an item, initiate an exchange request through your account or contact customer service. Select your replacement item and we will ship it as soon as we receive your return. If the replacement item costs more, you will be charged the difference. If it costs less, we will refund the difference. Exchanges for the same item in a different size or color ship with expedited shipping at no extra cost.
